name: Barker Brothers Building
heritage: National Register of Historic Places contributing property
text: Barker Brothers Building, also known as Sassony Building and The Barker, is a historic seven-story building located at 722 S. Broadway in the Broadway Theater District in the historic core of downtown Los Angeles. The building's original tenant was Barker Bros., for which it is named after.
